alt.en: The research proposes checking and regenerating agent messages against explicit role contracts. Its arXiv abstract reports improvements, but the saved source does not establish deployment behavior or reproducible results.
alt.zh: 这项研究提出依据明确的角色契约检查并重新生成智能体消息。arXiv 摘要报告了效果提升，但保存的来源不足以核实部署行为或复现实验结果。
